name: New Zealand
dek: Wellington Aero AWS, WMO 93439. The capital, on Cook Strait.
paragraphs: The reference station is Wellington Aero AWS, WMO 93439, height 4 m. Auckland Aero (93110) is a separate file and was not averaged in, and the South Island is not this table. January is midsummer.

The highest average high in the table is 21.2 °C, in February. The lowest average low is 7.1 °C, in July. The wettest month by the precipitation column is July, at 109.7 mm, and the driest is January, at 60.0 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Wellington Aero AWS, WMO 93439. Not Auckland and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Wellington Aero AWS (93439)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows New Zealand at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Tourism New Zealand's driving page says: "we drive on the left side of the road in New Zealand."
driving.sourceTitle: NewZealand.com (Tourism New Zealand), driving in New Zealand

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.value: Not obligatory; no service charge added
tipping.detail: Tourism New Zealand's currency and costs page says tipping is not obligatory, even in restaurants and bars, that tipping for good service is at the visitor's discretion, and that hotels and restaurants do not add service charges to their bills.
tipping.sourceTitle: NewZealand.com (Tourism New Zealand), currency and costs

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for New Zealand, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name New Zealand Dollar and the code NZD for New Zealand. It lists the same currency for several Pacific territories.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.value: Pacific/Auckland for most of the country; 2 zones
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives New Zealand two rows: Pacific/Auckland, commented most of New Zealand, and Pacific/Chatham for the Chatham Islands.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: Immigration New Zealand's site. We do not restate a visa rule.
